subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu plugin send message fails with 400 error - receive_id_type is required

question: Should maintainers close the conflicting fork PR and promote a fresh narrow Feishu target-validation fix, or adopt that branch first?
rationale: The remaining source-level bug is bounded, but there is an open conflicting fork PR with closing syntax and a closed same-repo predecessor, so automation should not create a competing repair until maintainers choose the canonical path.

options.title: Close stale fork and queue a replacement
options.body: Close the conflicting fork copy as non-viable, then allow a narrow Feishu plugin fix PR with tests and live proof to become the canonical path.

options.title: Adopt the fork branch
options.body: Ask a maintainer to take over the fork branch, resolve conflicts, fix the known type/proof blockers, and review it as the canonical PR.

options.title: Wait for live reproduction first
options.body: Keep the issue parked until someone supplies redacted Feishu/Lark runtime proof before choosing a code path.

recommendation.title: Close stale fork and queue a replacement
recommendation.body: Close the conflicting fork copy as non-viable, then allow a narrow Feishu plugin fix PR with tests and live proof to become the canonical path.
